title: Where Is the Truth When AI Agents Disagree? Dependence-Aware Belief Propagation for Unsupervised Truth Discovery (Extended Version)
title_zh: 当AI智能体意见不一致时，真相何在？面向无监督真相发现的依赖感知信念传播（扩展版）

paragraphs.en: 提出BP-TD方法，通过去相关权重在无标签条件下对意见分歧的LLM智能体进行真相发现与可靠性估计。 LLM agents often give conflicting answers to the same question, and many deployed agents are variants of one base model, so their errors are correlated. We study truth discovery among such agents: inferring the true answer and each agent's reliability without labels. Classical truth-discovery and crowdsourcing estimators reward an agreeing bloc and can fall below majority vote. We propose BP-TD, which adds per-agent decorrelation weights to mean-field variational inference on a one-coin Dawid-Skene model, so that agents sharing a base model count together as about one vote. Its first iteration is exactly a weighted vote; later iterations estimate agent reliability. With 13 local agents on MMLU, BP-TD beats majority vote without any labels (0.716 vs. 0.624 on 160 questions; 0.707 vs. 0.674 on 10,000) and ranks agents by their true accuracy, which classical estimators invert. The gain depends on the pool: over 2,852 sub-pools of four benchmarks, decorrelation helps when the largest correlated bloc is weaker than the other agents and hurts when it is the strongest, and we found no label-free statistic that tells the two cases apart. Labels change the picture quickly: with 20 labelled questions, selecting the single best agent is more accurate than every aggregator we tested on MMLU, ARC and TruthfulQA.
paragraphs.zh: 提出BP-TD方法，通过去相关权重在无标签条件下对意见分歧的LLM智能体进行真相发现与可靠性估计。LLM智能体对同一问题常常给出相互矛盾的答案，而且许多已部署的智能体都是同一基础模型的变体，因此它们的错误是相关的。 我们研究这类智能体之间的真相发现：在无标签条件下推断真实答案以及每个智能体的可靠性。 经典的真相发现与众包估计器会奖励达成一致的群体，其性能可能低于多数投票。 我们提出BP-TD，在单硬币Dawid-Skene模型的平均场变分推断基础上加入逐智能体的去相关权重，使共享同一基础模型的智能体合计只相当于大约一票。 其首次迭代恰好是一次加权投票；后续迭代则估计各智能体的可靠性。 在MMLU上使用13个本地智能体，BP-TD在无任何标签的情况下胜过多数投票（在160个问题上为0.716对0.624；在10,000个问题上为0.707对0.674），并能按智能体的真实准确率进行排序，而经典估计器会得出相反的排序。 收益取决于智能体池的构成：在四个基准的2,852个子池上，当最大相关群体弱于其他智能体时去相关有帮助，而当它是最强时则有害，我们未找到能在无标签条件下区分这两种情形的统计量。 标签会迅速改变局面：仅有20个带标签的问题时，直接选出单个最佳智能体就比我们在MMLU、ARC和TruthfulQA上测试的所有聚合器都更准确。
